content.text:
I wrote the migrated file to `out/module.ts`. The bundle is 741 bytes min+gzip, of which 113 bytes are my own code. I didn't run the original `src/module.ts` against it, so the "results equal the original" check is untested. I only ran `truncate` by hand on one 30-character string (it gave `abcdefghijklmnopqrstu...`).

`tsc --noEmit` reports no errors for `out/module.ts`. Its only errors are in `src/module.ts`, which still imports lodash, and lodash isn't installed.

| lodash | Replacement | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `pick(row, ['id','name'])` | `pick` from `es-toolkit` | Same call shape. |
| `sumBy(rows, 'age')` | `sumBy` from `es-toolkit` | The strict version only takes a function, so the adapter is `r => r.age`. |
| `truncate(text, {length: 24})` | `truncate` from `es-toolkit/compat` | es-toolkit has no strict `truncate`, so it comes from compat, which still removes the lodash dependency. |

The exported `Row` and `Config` types and the three function signatures are unchanged.

I picked strict `sumBy` over the compat one, which accepts the `'age'` string, to keep the bundle smaller. `truncate` has no strict equivalent, so compat was the only option.
